statement: Build a string by taking one character from word1, then one from word2, repeating while both have characters. When one ends, append the unused tail of the other.
constraints: Each word contains 1–100 lowercase English letters.
hints: Conceptual: Each word must keep its original order.
Directional: Track the next unread position in each word.
Implementation: Emit a character from each available word at each position, then continue with the longer word.
